product.name: Sinotruck Pickup Commercial Version
product.description: SINOTRUCK pickup commercial version is designed for business use with enhanced cargo capacity and durability.

performanceItems.title: 2.0T turbocharged direct injection engine + 8AT gearbox
performanceItems.description: 2.0T turbocharged engine, good power and fuel economy, The engine is mated to an 8AT transmission, and the power response is smooth

performanceItems.description: Front MacPherson independent suspension, rear multi-link independent suspension. The body is strong and stable, ensuring a smooth driving experience.
